client_values.aptitudes: cpetattr original min/max fields; preserve each selected integer in instance storage
client_values.growth: cpetattr original growrate list; preserve selected raw integer
client_values.experience: cpetnextexp original values; no fitted polynomial

generation.sampling_note: Deterministic restoration baseline; no claim of recovered rarity or random probabilities. Never reroll persisted instances.

experience_policy.semantics: subtract current-level row exp for each successful level increase; carry remaining experience
experience_policy.at_level_cap: retain unspent experience without further leveling

attribute_points.provenance: designed; growth_raw / 100 direction is supported only by historical official guide
attribute_points.allocation: nonnegative integers only; sum of allocated <= free_earned; persist allocation
attribute_points.growth_below_500: reject profile as incompatible, never create negative automatic points
attribute_points.remainder: calculate cumulative totals from raw integers; no per-level float rounding
attribute_points.evolution_bloodline_skills: separate explicit modifiers; not included in this baseline

derived_attributes.variables: L=level; V=vitality; I=inner_power; S=strength; E=endurance; A=agility; QA/QD/QV/QM/QS are selected original aptitude integers
derived_attributes.bounds: HP>=1, MP>=0, speed>=1, other derived values>=0; reject integer overflow
derived_attributes.growth_application: growth changes point totals only; do not multiply derived attributes again
derived_attributes.vitality_after_upgrade: preserve missing HP/MP: current=min(new_max, max(0, old_current + new_max - old_max)); a dead pet stays at HP0
derived_attributes.view_refresh: only encode native fields after each meaning is confirmed

persistence.transaction: pet XP, level, points, resource changes, revision and settlement receipt commit together
persistence.existing_pet: explicit one-time migration required; constructor zero defaults are not recovered stats
persistence.reward_recipient: explicit pet_instance_id; no silent selection of first pet
persistence.battle: immutable versioned snapshot; integrate after player and pet attribute scales are checked
